shellRecipe: opam exec -- dune exec examples/showcase_graph.exe
cabal update

(
LIBTMUX_DEMO_DIR=$(mktemp -d -t libtmux-haskell-demo.XXXXXX) && \
trap 'tmux -N -S "$LIBTMUX_DEMO_DIR/s" kill-server; rm -r -- "$LIBTMUX_DEMO_DIR"' EXIT && \
env -u TMUX -u TMUX_PANE tmux \
    -S "$LIBTMUX_DEMO_DIR/s" \
    -f /dev/null \
    new-session \
    -d \
    -s demo \
    -n editor \
    -x 120 \
    -y 40 \
    /bin/cat - && \
env -u TMUX -u TMUX_PANE tmux \
    -N \
    -S "$LIBTMUX_DEMO_DIR/s" \
    link-window \
    -s demo:0 \
    -t demo:4 && \
cabal run --verbose=0 mutate-graph -- \
    "$LIBTMUX_DEMO_DIR/s" \
    "$(command -v tmux)"
)
perl examples/quickstart.pl

git clone \
  --branch master \
  --single-branch \
  https://github.com/libtmux/libtmux-java libtmux-source && \
  git -C libtmux-source checkout --detach 941f2162062b6d118c68b7d1c23417e0d2cea124 && \
  (cd libtmux-source && ./gradlew \
    :libtmux:publishToMavenLocal \
    :libtmux-clojure:publishToMavenLocal \
    --max-workers=1 \
    --console=plain \
    "-Dmaven.repo.local=$PWD/../m2")
clojure -J-Dclojure.main.report=stderr -M quickstart.clj

git init -q source
git -C source fetch -q --depth=1 \
  https://github.com/libtmux/libtmux-lisp.git \
  99874b44dbe29b3651597a5debbacccde235d96c
git -C source checkout -q --detach FETCH_HEAD
mise trust source
mise -C source install

unset TMUX TMUX_PANE
export ENV=/dev/null BASH_ENV=/dev/null SHELL=/bin/sh
export LIBTMUX_SOURCE="$PWD/source"
export LIBTMUX_PROGRAM="${LIBTMUX_NATIVE_TMUX:-$(command -v tmux)}"
LIBTMUX_DEMO_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
export LIBTMUX_EXAMPLE_SOCKET="$LIBTMUX_DEMO_DIR/tmux.sock"
trap 'rm -rf "$LIBTMUX_DEMO_DIR"' EXIT
tmux -S "$LIBTMUX_EXAMPLE_SOCKET" -f /dev/null \
  new-session -d -s demo -n editor -x 80 -y 24 -- /bin/cat
LIBTMUX_ASDF="$(mise -C source where http:asdf-lisp)/asdf.lisp"
mise -C source exec -- sbcl --noinform --no-sysinit --no-userinit \
  --load "$LIBTMUX_ASDF" --script "$PWD/quickstart.lisp"
expectedOutputs: %1 is in window editor of session demo
